datasets.name: Landsat 5, 7, and 8 surface reflectance data
datasets.verbatim: Surface reflectance is acquired from Landsat 5, 7, and 8 images, courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey.

datasets.name: NASADEM global elevation model
datasets.verbatim: DEM is provided by NASADEM (Crippen et al., 2016).

datasets.name: Global Lithological Map (GLiM)
datasets.verbatim: Lithology is achieved from Global Lithological Map (Hartmann & Moosdorf, 2012).

datasets.name: ShakeMap PGA and PGV
datasets.verbatim: PGA and PGV of the Wenchuan earthquake are obtained from ShakeMap (Wald et al., 2022).

datasets.name: CHIRPS precipitation data
datasets.verbatim: Precipitation is provided by CHIRPS (Funk et al., 2015).

datasets.name: MODIS LST, ET, LAI, EVI, GPP, and NPP products
datasets.source: NASA EOSDIS Land Processes Distributed Active Archive Center
datasets.verbatim: LST, ET, LAI, EVI, GPP, and NPP are all obtained from MODIS products (Didan, 2021; Myneni et al., 2021; Running & Zhao, 2019; Running et al., 2015, 2017; Wan et al., 2021).

datasets.name: Land cover data sets for training
datasets.source: Gong et al., Zanaga et al., and X. Zhang et al.
datasets.verbatim: The land cover data sets which we considered for training sample collection in CCDC are provided by Gong et al. (2019), Zanaga et al. (2021), and X. Zhang et al. (2021).

datasets.name: Time-series landslide detection achievements
datasets.verbatim: The time‐series landslide detection achievements are released in Wang et al. (2023).

methods.name: Time-series landslide detection approach (modified CCDC)
methods.summary: A framework that utilizes time-series Landsat images and the Continuous Change Detection and Classification (CCDC) algorithm to identify landslides by detecting spectral deviations from model predictions and classifying land cover changes to vegetation.
methods.verbatim: The time‐series landslide detection approach is modified based on CCDC algorithm, which is provided by Zhu and Woodcock (2014).
